purpose: Close the last open residual of the red team's F-1: full states do not collide across a structured key set, but does a PROJECTION of the state collide, permitting partial work sharing that never forms the full state?
measured_by: dispatching session (Bash), coordinator-side - NOT independent validation
method: Affine master-key coset, dimension 12, set size 4096, fixed plaintext. For each round, count distinct values of four projections of the intermediate state: 1 byte, 1 column (4 bytes), 1 diagonal (4 bytes), 8 bytes. A projection permits sharing only if its distinct count is materially BELOW the set size. Each projection is capped by min(its own value space, set size).

measured.1_byte: 256 at every round 1-10 - saturates its own 256-value space, so sharing DOES occur, and it is exactly the S-box table saturation already accounted for
measured.1_column_4B: 4096 at every round = set size - FULLY DISTINCT, no sharing
measured.1_diagonal_4B: 4096 at every round = set size - FULLY DISTINCT, no sharing
measured.8_bytes: 4096 at every round = set size - FULLY DISTINCT, no sharing

resolution: Partial sharing across a structured key set exists ONLY at byte granularity, which is precisely the S-box lookup amortization already measured and already capped at 2^15.64 total. At four bytes and wider the projection is fully distinct at every round, so no test operating on a projection wider than a byte can share work across candidates. The residual form of F-1 is closed for these families: there is no intermediate granularity at which sharing appears.
net_effect_on_O3: O-3's premise is false, its conclusion survives, and now the mechanism is fully characterised: sharing is real but strictly byte-local, and byte-local sharing is bounded by the 200 x 256 table. Per-candidate work above byte granularity is irreducible for the families measured.
not_established: Measured on affine master-key cosets at d=12 with four fixed projections. Other structured families and other projections - in particular non-coordinate projections such as linear combinations across bytes - are unmeasured.
This closes a residual in an ARGUMENT. It is not progress toward an attack and no attack is implied.
No claim about AES security. No impossibility claim.
Coordinator-side; shares the campaign's single model under 0137a051; not independent validation.
